text:
sanjay: idea: replace multiple per-feature peering endpoints with one tiny connector endpoint in customer VPCs. single TLS, single auth exchange.
marie: sounds promising. main concerns: cert rotation scale and safe fallback for network blips.
taylor: propose bootstrap token + short-lived mTLS certs (token rotated ~6h, certs 1h). token stored in agent/KMS.
dominik: observability: collapsing endpoints shouldn't reduce per-tenant metrics. carry signed tenant-id header and emit metrics in CP without logging payloads.
marie: must HMAC the header. don't rely on src ip.
sanjay: fallback modes: connector-local cache (5m default, max-stale 30m) and regional relay read-only if needed. alarms if stale>5m.
dominik: relays costy—prefer local enforcement and aggressive throttles on relay. I'll draft throttling policy.
taylor: rollout: staging impl -> caching-only 2w -> 5% canary -> ramp with health gates (error>0.5%, p50>200ms, stale alarms).
deploy-bot: CI: connector-auth e2e passed (build 501).
marie: add feature flag per-account: legacy/hybrid/connector-only.
sanjay: security checklist: bootstrap rotation, HMAC verification, short certs, tenant telemetry isolation, audit token issuance.
taylor: I'll own tests and monitor playbook. dominik: I'll provide cost thresholds + relay ops runbook.
marie: I'll file RFC follow-up doc and sequence diagrams. tagging infra and oncall.
sanjay: ok to proceed with PoC.
